audit.whatIsWrong: The page reads as a stomp — 'Own him completely', 'this whole matchup is yours to front-run' — on a matchup recorded at 45.42% over 262 games, the worst win rate in my slice.
audit.why: Pantheon loses this lane by four and a half points and the chart still gives him five of seven stages, which the packet flags directly. The prose amplifies the error rather than hedging it. The sample is small at 262 games, but nothing on the page acknowledges that the recorded result disagrees with the confidence of the writing.
audit.corrected: The early text's stomp framing softened to a real early advantage with a stated deadline. The chart cells could not be changed — see notes.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] has three entries where four are expected, and the missing row is Yi's two-item spike.
audit.why: Same shape as the Locke page: three Pantheon rows and nothing for the stage where Highlander resets and Wuju Style's true damage actually decide the game. The packet flags the count.
audit.corrected: Not added — adding an entry changes the count. The existing first-item row now carries the real reason his duel improves, and the gap is flagged.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'The passive block eats his counter-trades' in early, and 'your poke and passive block' in whys[0]. Mortal Will does not block anything.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.' It is a stack meter on your casts. The only thing in your kit that blocks damage is Aegis Assault, and it is invulnerable from the front only. Telling the player his passive absorbs counter-trades means he stops holding the one cooldown that does.
audit.corrected: Both instances moved to Aegis Assault, with the directional limit stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one Yi ability is named except Highlander, and the two interactions that decide the lane are both absent.
audit.why: First: Meditate is a channel on a flat 10s that heals him and cuts incoming damage — and Shield Vault is a point-and-click stun, so it cancels the channel outright. That is a free kill button against the button Yi uses to survive your all-in, and it was nowhere on the page. Second: Alpha Strike makes him untargetable for the dash, on 20/19.5/19/18.5/18s. Burst spent as he starts it is burst thrown away, and 20 seconds is the longest basic cooldown in the matchup — that is the window to fight in, not his item timings.
audit.corrected: Meditate's channel and the Shield Vault cancel written into mid, Alpha Strike's untargetable dash and 20s cooldown into mid and the first-item spike.

audit.why: Meditate heals on a flat 10s and Yi builds lifesteal on top. Grievous Wounds is what makes the late duel survivable at all, and the page never mentions it while telling you the duel is lost.

notes: TWO THINGS FOR THE USER. First, this is the worst win rate in my slice — 45.42% — and both the chart and the prose treat it as a stomp. The chart gives Pantheon five of seven stages, which the packet flags as contradicting the data, and I could not correct it: 'Pantheon' to 'Master Yi' is nine characters against eight and fails the length band, and 'Skill' fails it too. Those cells need a hand fix, and 262 games is a thin sample worth a second look before anyone trusts either number. Second, spikes[] has three entries instead of four and the missing row is Yi's two-item spike, so the page has nothing to say about the only stage he wins. BEST ADDITION: Meditate is a channel on a flat 10s cooldown and Shield Vault is a point-and-click stun, so the stun cancels the heal outright. That is the single highest-value line available in this matchup and it was absent from both layers. Also added Alpha Strike's untargetable dash on 20/19.5/19/18.5/18s — the longest basic cooldown in the lane and the actual window to fight in. Finally, 'the passive block' appeared twice; Mortal Will empowers Pantheon's next spell and blocks nothing. That is the same stale passive description the kassadin mirror agent reported, now confirmed on a third page — a grep of champ-data for 'passive block' looks worthwhile.
